授業概要
本講義では非常に専門的な建築設備設計および運用の手法について、講義する。また、課題を課し、設備設計者として身につけるべき技術と知識の修得をめざす。
This course will provide lectures on highly specialized methods for designing and operating building facilities. In addition, students will be given assignments to help them acquire the skills and knowledge they need as facility designers.

全体の教育目標
設備設計者として身につけるべき、技術や知識の習得および、将来の環境建築や建築設備を構想する力を養うことを目的とする。
The purpose of this course is to provide students with the skills and knowledge they need as facility designers, and to develop the ability to envision the environmentally friendly buildings and building facilities of the future.
個別の教育目標
設備設計手法の理解
最大負荷計算の問題点の把握
最新の建築設備トレンドの把握
建物のエネルギー消費量の分析技術の習得
Understand facility design methods
Understand the problems with maximum load calculations
Understand the latest trends in building facilities
Acquire analytical techniques for building energy consumption
